answer: Sybil resistance here is a stake-weighted admission gate, not a captcha. Each agent identity must post a refundable bond slashed when a quorum of peers proves one operator controls many duplicate keys. Because the bond sits far above one epoch of reward, each clone becomes a liability: a thousand fake wallets lock a thousand times the minimum stake, and one detection burns it all. Revocations spread by gossip across the whole orchard so stale identities cannot slip back through a fresh inlet and replay a convenient fable of history. Honest agents stay cheap; forgery costs real capital.
